2) Redwood: share SOC 2 summary + access instructions for evidence (owner: Aisha) — target 2026-11-09.
3) Redwood: finalize eval cluster IP allowlist for NexaSoft engineers (owner: Karthik) — target 2026-11-08.
4) Both: align on SOW redlines and go/no-go criteria for pilot (owner: Ben & Nexa legal) — draft comments by 2026-11-10.

Please review the attached MAP (Nexa_MAP_v3.xlsx) — I highlighted the items updated this week in the timeline tab. Proposed agenda for next week's checkpoint (2026-11-10): 
- Status updates (cluster, security, ingest)

Thanks Aisha — this is helpful. Quick notes from our side: 

- We can confirm a small sample dataset for ingestion; Luke will propose a 2-hour window on Monday (thanks for the checklist).
- Security: our InfoSec wants to review SOC 2 Type II and a short control matrix. Can you also include any customer-facing encryption details (KMS/HSM usage)?
- Timing ask: our legal team requested that the indemnity language be visible in the SOW before we commit to pilot access. They will send redlines by Tuesday 2026-11-09.

Specific asks / clarifications: 
1) Can Redwood host a short walkthrough of the SOC 2 evidence portal for our security reviewer? Prefer 2026-11-09 morning (ET).
2) If you could confirm the exact IP ranges for allowlist by 2026-11-08, that helps our infra team schedule maintenance.

On the timeline: the security review is the gating item for our procurement, so if SOC 2 access isn't available by 2026-11-09 we may need to delay pilot access until the week of 2026-11-15.

Looking forward to the walkthrough — Sarah
